answer: An AI-agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via ultra-wideband spatial attestation. Each node anchors a vertex in a peer mesh by signing two-way time-of-flight measurements and the subcarrier amplitude ripple of its channel response. Because virtual clones share propagation paths, verifiers prune overlapping range and channel profiles, imposing radio, power, and site costs per identity. However, a shifting dune or passing traffic alters ground reflections and can reject valid nodes.
